item.title: Lithic: Senior Software Engineer, Product Platform
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.

Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.

We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. 

We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.

Remote | Full-Time | UK 

About Us

At Medify, we’re on a mission to widen access to medicine and healthcare careers through world-class digital learning experiences. Since 2009, we’ve helped thousands of students prepare for high-stakes admissions tests, and we’re continuing to invest in our technology to build innovative, scalable products that support learners around the world.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead, mentor and develop our engineering team while remaining hands-on in building the platform that powers Medify.

The Role

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping both our engineering culture and technical direction. Working closely with the CTO, Product and Design teams, you’ll lead a team of talented full-stack engineers, helping them grow while ensuring we continue to deliver high-quality software that delights our users.

item.title: Toptal: Salesforce Developers with AI-Assisted Coding Experience
item.description:
Headquarters:

We are looking for Salesforce Developers for a global company. Their goal is to accelerate Salesforce delivery across Flows, Lightning Web Components, and Apex while using AI copilots and agents to improve delivery speed, testing, and documentation.

General Information

  • Location: Remote. Talents from the USA or Canada.
  • Overlap: 6hs with East Coast time zone, USA
  • Commitment: full-time
  • Length: 12+ months

Required Skills:

  • 3–6+ years of Salesforce development experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with Apex
  • Strong experience building Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • Strong experience with Salesforce Flow
  • Experience with Git-based development and pull request workflows
  • Strong automated testing mindset, including unit testing and security checks
  • Experience validating Salesforce security, sharing rules, bulkification, and governor limits
  • Experience integrating Salesforce components with APIs and MuleSoft-facing solutions
  • Daily experience using AI copilots or coding agents for discovery, development, testing, and documentation
